resources.string: Accurate prayer timings for your location, real-time community Jamaat updates, and Hayya \'alas-salah voice alerts even when your phone is locked.
Maghrib Jamaat defaults to 5 min after Azan because the sunset window is brief, while Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, and Isha default to 15 min.
A new version of Namaz Time is ready. Tap Update to download the latest APK.
